stories.title: Milwaukee's 44-Year Wait — The City Behind the Brewers

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
44 years since Milwaukee hosted a World Series game.

The last time was 1982. Robin Yount. Paul Molitor. They lost in 7 to the Cardinals.

Tomorrow night at American Family Field, an entire generation gets to experience this for the first time.

#Brewers #WorldSeries #Milwaukee

article.headline: Milwaukee's 44-Year Wait: The City Behind the Brewers Has Finally Made It Back
